description: This file contains unit tests for the IdempotencyKeyResolver class in the Fineract project, testing its behavior in resolving idempotency keys from various sources such as request context, generated values, or command wrappers.

classes.name: IdempotencyKeyResolverTest
classes.description: Unit test class for IdempotencyKeyResolver, testing resolve logic from request context, generated keys, and command wrapper.

methods.name: setup
